summary: Santander UK Group Holdings plc furnished a Form 6-K dated September 15, 2026, incorporating exhibits into its Form F-3 shelf registration statement (File No. 333-280673). The filing covers a Thirteenth Supplemental Indenture with Citibank, N.A. as trustee, paving the way for two senior note series: $1.5 billion 5.314% fixed/floating notes due 2030 and $1.0 billion 6.046% fixed/floating notes due 2037. It also includes Cleary Gottlieb US and English legal opinions. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, with no M&A, tender, activist, or restructuring element; risk-arb angle is not applicable.
